description: Boolean status flag stored as string with inconsistent textual and numeric representations. Contains 6 distinct values ('0', '1', 'False', 'True', 'no', 'yes') representing binary true/false states across 30 records with no missing values.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert string representations to boolean type: 'True' → True, '1' → True, 'yes' → True, 'False' → False, '0' → False, 'no' → False.
[VALIDATE] Verify all values conform to boolean format (True/False) after standardization.
